estimator: robust sigma = 1.4826 x median|d| / sqrt(2) over pairs of independent same-class measurements of one state (zero-mean differences); 95 % percentile bootstrap over states
independence: one value per primary source and state (origin.measured_in, else the single cited source, else the reporting paper for its own work, else the reporting paper marked unattributed; median of the source's values); identical values from different sources are counted once (one measurement re-listed)

priors.drowart2005: J. Drowart, C. Chatillon, J. Hastie, D. Bonnell, High-temperature mass spectrometry: instrumental techniques, ionization cross-sections, pressure measurements, and thermodynamic data (IUPAC Technical Report), Pure Appl. Chem. 77 (2005) 683-737, doi:10.1351/pac200577040683 (second-law enthalpies less accurate than third-law; systematic errors dominate the stated precision)
priors.espei: ESPEI 0.9.1 experimental reference sigmas (500 J/mol for enthalpies and the chemical potential of activities, 0.2 J/mol/K for entropies and heat capacities; espei/error_functions, 'estimated from NIST TRC uncertainties')
priors.kirklin2015: S. Kirklin et al., The Open Quantum Materials Database (OQMD): assessing the accuracy of DFT formation energies, npj Comput. Mater. 1 (2015) 15010, doi:10.1038/npjcompumats.2015.10 (mean absolute difference between independent experimental formation enthalpies 0.082 eV/atom, about 8 kJ/mol-atom, over compounds with more than one experimental value)
priors.kubaschewski: O. Kubaschewski, C.B. Alcock, P.J. Spencer, Materials Thermochemistry, 6th ed., Pergamon, 1993 (chapter 2, accuracy of experimental methods: calorimetric formation enthalpies typically +-1-2 kJ/mol-atom, EMF and vapour-pressure-derived values less accurate, entropies from the temperature coefficient of EMF or second-law vapour-pressure evaluation the least)
priors.orchid_assumed: ORCHID assumption (PI decision 2026-10-24), stated so that it can be replaced; not fitted

rule: sigma_effective = max( sqrt( max(sigma_printed, sigma_reading, sigma_method)^2 + sigma_composition^2 + sigma_conversion^2 ), sigma_scatter ); absent components drop out. The method floor is a between-study scatter and already contains each study's statistical error, so it is not added to the printed sigma in quadrature (no double counting): the larger of the two is used. The composition offset and the conversion are independent of the measurement and are added in quadrature. The scatter of a page-checked mutually inconsistent group replaces the result when larger. The reading resolution alone is not an uncertainty estimate: without a printed sigma, a method floor or a group scatter, sigma_effective is null (with the reason).
sample: experimental, extraction_accepted, no blocking flag (unsigned_in_print, magnitude_suspect, system_mismatch, source_disputed); values convertible to the value type's canonical unit; formation quantities on a per-atom basis only
